n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: You'll never guess. A man handed in my purse at the café! Everything's still in it. I want to thank him. Did you see him?

translations.fa: باورت نمیشه. یه آقا کیف پولم را تو کافه تحویل داده! همه‌چی هنوز توشه. می‌خوام ازش تشکر کنم. دیدیش؟

branches.suggestion: Yes! He was here a minute ago.
branches.suggestionFa: آره! یه دقیقه پیش اینجا بود.

branches.suggestion: No, I didn't. What does he look like?

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Callum said "older man, beard". That's half of Hackney! You were by the gate. What did he look like?

translations.fa: کالوم گفت «یه آقای مسن، ریش‌دار». این نصف هکنیه! تو کنار در بودی. چه شکلی بود؟

branches.suggestion: He's got grey hair and a short white beard.
branches.suggestionFa: موهاش خاکستریه و یه ریش کوتاه سفید داره.

branches.suggestion: He's quite tall and thin. About seventy, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: نسبتاً قدبلند و لاغره. فکر کنم حدود هفتاد.

cultureNote.en: In English, "hair" (on your head) is uncountable: "He's got grey hair", not "grey hairs".

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: Grey hair, white beard, tall and thin. Good. What was he wearing? There are three old men by the pond.

translations.fa: موی خاکستری، ریش سفید، قدبلند و لاغر. خوبه. چی پوشیده بود؟ سه تا آقای مسن کنار برکه‌ان.

branches.suggestion: He was wearing a green coat and a flat cap.
branches.suggestionFa: یه کت سبز و کلاه کپ پوشیده بود.

branches.suggestion: He had a brown dog with him. A small one.
branches.suggestionFa: یه سگ قهوه‌ای کوچیک همراهش بود.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: A flat cap! Very Hackney grandad. And glasses? Some of them have glasses.

translations.fa: کلاه کپ! خیلی پدربزرگ‌های هکنی. و عینک؟ بعضی‌هاشون عینک دارن.

branches.suggestion: Yes, round glasses. And a big smile.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، عینک گرد. و یه لبخند بزرگ.

branches.suggestion: I'm not sure about glasses. Sorry.

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: Look — on the bench. Green coat, flat cap, round glasses, little brown dog. That must be him!

translations.fa: ببین — رو نیمکت. کت سبز، کلاه کپ، عینک گرد، سگ کوچیک قهوه‌ای. حتماً خودشه!

branches.suggestion: Yes, that's him! Let's go and say thank you.
Are you sure? He looks different now.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: Oh! It's Mr Jenkins from next door! I didn't recognise him in the cap. He always wears a hat to the park.

translations.fa: اوه! آقای جنکینزه، همسایه! با کلاه نشناختمش. همیشه برای پارک کلاه سرش می‌ذاره.

branches.suggestion: Mr Jenkins! The man with the wonky stripes!
branches.suggestionFa: آقای جنکینز! همون که راه‌راه‌هاش کجه!

n7.speaker: leslie
n7.text: Ha! Shh! He was so kind. I'll bake him a cake. What does he like? You talk to him more than I do.

translations.fa: ها! هیس! خیلی مهربون بود. براش کیک می‌پزم. چی دوست داره؟ تو بیشتر از من باهاش حرف می‌زنی.

branches.suggestion: He likes lemon cake. He told me last week.
branches.suggestionFa: کیک لیمو دوست داره. هفتهٔ پیش بهم گفت.

branches.suggestion: He likes his dog more than cake, I think!
branches.suggestionFa: فکر کنم سگش را بیشتر از کیک دوست داره!

n8.speaker: leslie
n8.text: Lemon cake it is. And look — he's waving. "Leslie! Your purse!" Yes, Mr Jenkins! Thank you SO much!

translations.fa: پس کیک لیمو. و ببین — داره دست تکون میده. «لزلی! کیف پولت!» آره آقای جنکینز! خیلی خیلی ممنون!
